question: Calculate the average pick percentage for each product name, using a first-in-first-out approach that selects from inventory locations based on the earliest purchase date and smallest available quantity, ensuring that the picked quantity reflects only the overlapping range between each order’s required quantity and the inventory’s available quantity, and then grouping and ordering the results by product name?
sql:
-- Final solution: average pick percentage per product name using FIFO
WITH RECURSIVE 
inv_data AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory i
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),
ord_data AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as order_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.order_id) as rn
    FROM orderlines ol
),
alloc AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.product_id, o.order_qty, o.rn,
           inv_data.total_inv as remaining_inv,
           LEAST(o.order_qty, inv_data.total_inv) as picked
    FROM ord_data o
    JOIN inv_data ON o.product_id = inv_data.product_id
    WHERE o.rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT o.order_id, o.product_id, o.order_qty, o.rn,
           a.remaining_inv - a.picked,
           LEAST(o.order_qty, a.remaining_inv - a.picked)
    FROM alloc a
    JOIN ord_data o ON a.product_id = o.product_id AND o.rn = a.rn + 1
),
pick_pct AS (
    SELECT a.order_id, a.product_id, p.name as product_name, a.order_qty, a.picked,
           CASE WHEN a.order_qty > 0 THEN 1.0 * a.picked / a.order_qty ELSE 0 END as pick_pct
    FROM alloc a
    JOIN products p ON a.product_id = p.id
)
SELECT product_name, 
       ROUND(AVG(pick_pct) * 100, 2) as avg_pick_percentage
FROM pick_pct
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY product_name
